Resolve a Download URL via CKAN package_show

Source: R/lib_data_loader.R
rslvckan.Rd

Asks a CKAN open-data portal for the current list of files in a dataset and returns the URL of the first file whose name matches the pattern pinned in the provenance record. CKAN powers data.ontario.ca, data.gov.uk, data.gov and most government open-data portals; when a portal replaces a file (a new resource UUID, a new URL) the dataset page stays the same, so this recovers the current download URL without editing the project.

Usage

rslvckan(prov)

Arguments

prov

A provenance list as returned by loadprov(), or NULL. A lookup is made only when it has both of these fields:

  • dataset$ckan_api_endpoint;

  • resource$name_match_pattern.

Value

The matched resource URL as a length-1 character string, or NULL as described in Details.

Details

The function reads dataset$ckan_api_endpoint, the full URL, which ends in /api/3/action/ and package_show?id=<slug>. It also reads resource$name_match_pattern, a regular expression. It fetches the endpoint as JSON, and walks result$resources in the order the portal lists them. The first resource whose name matches the pattern (case-insensitively, with grepl()) wins. If the slug itself has changed, rslvckns() is the fallback.

NULL is returned, without an error, when prov is NULL, when either field is missing or empty, when the request fails (offline, HTTP error, invalid JSON), when CKAN answers "success": false, or when no resource name matches. Errors are raised for a prov that is not a list, for an endpoint that is not a public https URL (plain http only when the option rmoriebricklayer.allowhttp is TRUE; loopback, private and link-local addresses are refused), and for a matched resource URL that fails the same check. One network request; nothing is written.

Examples

# Missing fields return NULL rather than erroring:
rslvckan(list())
#> NULL
rslvckan(NULL)
#> NULL

# the endpoint must be public https, checked before any request
prov <- list(
  dataset = list(ckan_api_endpoint = "http://localhost/api/3/action/package_show?id=x"),
  resource = list(name_match_pattern = "2014")
)
try(rslvckan(prov))
#> Error : ckan_api_endpoint must be an https:// URL, not http:// ('http://localhost/api/3/action/package_show?id=x'); options(rmoriebricklayer.allowhttp = TRUE) admits a trusted plain-http mirror
if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# needs the network: asks data.ontario.ca for the current file URL
prov <- list(
  dataset = list(ckan_api_endpoint = paste0(
    "https://data.ontario.ca/api/3/action/package_show",
    "?id=ontario-public-library-statistics"
  )),
  resource = list(name_match_pattern = "2014")
)
rslvckan(prov)
}
